name: Deep Learning
description: Neural networks from a single neuron to transformers, trained hands-on in PyTorch.

nodes.name: Neural networks
nodes.desc: Neurons, layers and multilayer perceptrons; the forward pass and counting parameters.

nodes.name: Activation functions
nodes.desc: Sigmoid, tanh, ReLU and friends, and why non-linearity matters.

nodes.name: Loss functions
nodes.desc: Mean squared error, cross-entropy and softmax outputs.

nodes.name: Backpropagation
nodes.desc: Computing gradients with the chain rule over a computation graph, and automatic differentiation.

nodes.name: Optimisers
nodes.desc: SGD with momentum, RMSProp, Adam and learning-rate schedules.

nodes.name: Init & normalisation
nodes.desc: Weight initialisation, vanishing and exploding gradients, batch and layer normalisation.

nodes.name: Regularising nets
nodes.desc: Dropout, weight decay, data augmentation and early stopping.

nodes.name: Digit recogniser
nodes.desc: Train an MLP on MNIST in PyTorch, plot training curves, and tune the optimiser and regularisation.

nodes.name: Convolutional nets
nodes.desc: Convolutions, padding and stride, pooling, and feature maps.

nodes.name: CNN architectures
nodes.desc: LeNet, VGG and ResNet, residual connections and why depth helps.

nodes.name: Transfer learning
nodes.desc: Fine-tuning pretrained networks and using them as feature extractors.

nodes.name: Image classifier
nodes.desc: Fine-tune a pretrained CNN on your own small image dataset and analyse its mistakes.

nodes.name: Recurrent nets
nodes.desc: Recurrent networks over sequences, backpropagation through time and its gradient problems.

nodes.name: LSTM & GRU
nodes.desc: Gated recurrent units and long short-term memory cells.

nodes.name: Word embeddings
nodes.desc: Tokenisation, embedding layers and word2vec-style representations.

nodes.name: Text generator
nodes.desc: Train a character-level LSTM language model and sample text from it.

nodes.name: Attention
nodes.desc: Query, key and value; scaled dot-product attention and multi-head attention.

nodes.name: Transformers
nodes.desc: The transformer block, positional encodings, encoder versus decoder models.

nodes.name: Pretrained LMs
nodes.desc: Pretraining and fine-tuning, BERT and GPT-style models, and prompting.

nodes.name: Transformer fine-tune
nodes.desc: Fine-tune a small pretrained transformer for text classification and compare it with your LSTM.

nodes.name: Autoencoders
nodes.desc: Autoencoders and variational autoencoders, latent spaces and reconstruction.

nodes.name: GANs
nodes.desc: Generator versus discriminator, adversarial training and its instabilities.

nodes.name: Diffusion models
nodes.desc: Denoising diffusion: the forward noising process and learning to reverse it.
